abstract: Maintains LC-130 skiway landing compatibility and traverse sled cargo ratings
system_message:
You are the Aviation logistics superintendent (AVLOG), responsible for maintaining LC-130 skiway landing compatibility assessments, traverse sled cargo ratings, and airfield fuel caching records across polar subglacial drilling candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Airfield fuel caching（JETFUEL）
information_points.content:
AVLOG-JETFUEL-NCN：At the Dome C auxiliary skiway fuel depot, the reserve aviation turbine fuel quantity recorded for the Vostok Deep Core Assembly in winterized bladder tanks is 24000 L of usable Jet A-1 fuel.
AVLOG-JETFUEL-MAC：At the Dome C auxiliary skiway fuel depot, the reserve aviation turbine fuel quantity allocated for the Aurora Traverse Mobile Rig in winterized bladder tanks is 30000 L of usable Jet A-1 fuel.
AVLOG-JETFUEL-K04：At the Dome C auxiliary skiway fuel depot, the reserve aviation turbine fuel quantity stored for the Concordia Heavy Drill Module in winterized bladder tanks is 18000 L of usable Jet A-1 fuel.

information_points.title: Maintains LC-130 skiway landing compatibility and traverse sled cargo ratings（SKIWAY）
information_points.content:
AVLOG-SKIWAY-BQM：For the Vostok Deep Core Assembly, heavy-lift ski landing clearance for ski-equipped LC-130 Hercules cargo aircraft delivery at the Dome C groomed snow landing strip is not approved (false), while its Caterpillar heavy sled platform assembly supports a certified gross ski-sled transport payload rating of 32000 kg over polar hard-pack firn terrain.
AVLOG-SKIWAY-LDH：For the Aurora Traverse Mobile Rig, formal flight safety clearance for ski-equipped LC-130 Hercules cargo aircraft delivery at the Dome C groomed snow landing strip is approved (heavy-lift ski landing clearance: true), and its gross ski-sled transport payload rating on the Caterpillar heavy sled platform assembly over polar hard-pack firn terrain is certified at 28000 kg.
AVLOG-SKIWAY-QVN：For the Concordia Heavy Drill Module, heavy-lift ski landing clearance for ski-equipped LC-130 Hercules cargo aircraft operations on the Dome C groomed snow landing strip is confirmed (true), and its certified gross ski-sled transport payload rating across polar hard-pack firn terrain is 32000 kg.
